local_checks.invariant: No secret or token is committed, logged or returned; tokens are encrypted with a random IV; signatures are compared in constant time; there is no fallback to unkeyed hashing or to no encryption.
local_checks.result: Random 96-bit IV per encryption, key length enforced, HKDF purpose separation for state, PKCE and ticket keys, crypto.subtle.verify for comparisons, errors reduced to codes, invocation logs disabled, no secret values in wrangler.jsonc or tracked files. hardening: packages/core/src/token-crypto.ts encrypts without additional authenticated data. Passing the shop (and token kind) as AES-GCM additionalData would make a ciphertext unusable in another shop's row.

local_checks.invariant: No request without a valid Shopify signature over its body reaches a handler, and a lower-trust principal cannot obtain a signed body to replay under another shop header.
local_checks.result: The signature is verified with crypto.subtle.verify before any header is read; shop, topic and triggered-at come from unsigned headers (same model as Shopify's own library). The only other app-secret HMAC a merchant can obtain is a session-token JWT, whose signed bytes are not valid JSON and are rejected at JSON.parse with 400. No reachable violation found; binding the header shop to the body's shop_domain is recorded as hardening.

hardening: shopify/app/shopify-webhook.server.ts:35-36 take topic and shop from headers the HMAC does not cover. For shop/redact and app/uninstalled, also compare the header shop with the body's shop_domain / myshopify_domain and reject on mismatch, so a signed body can never be replayed under another shop.
